## Markdown and YAML checks

- Add `markdown-length` to reject Markdown files over 1,000 lines, with guidance to archive or delete old content.
- Add `markdown-links` to check local Markdown links and images. External URLs and links in code examples are skipped.
- Add prek's built-in `check-yaml` to the example configuration, including support for multi-document YAML.

Copy the updated `example_conf/prek.toml` when upgrading to enable the new checks.
